phrases.english: Start again, learn from yesterday
phrases.spanish: Empieza otra vez, aprende de ayer

phrases.english: Small choices daily, create big change
phrases.spanish: Pequeñas decisiones, cada día, crean gran cambio

phrases.english: Be curious, try something new today
phrases.spanish: Sé curioso, prueba algo nuevo hoy

phrases.english: Fail forward, gather lessons, move on
phrases.spanish: Fracasa hacia adelante, recoge lecciones, sigue

phrases.english: Clear goals, steady effort, lasting results
phrases.spanish: Metas claras, esfuerzo constante, resultados duraderos

phrases.english: Stand tall, even when it shakes
phrases.spanish: Mantente firme, aunque tiemble

phrases.english: Breathe deep, then move forward
phrases.spanish: Respira profundo, y avanza

phrases.english: Small wins, build strong foundations
phrases.spanish: Pequeñas victorias, construyen fuerza

phrases.english: Hold your ground, quietly strong
phrases.spanish: Mantén tu terreno, con fuerza tranquila

phrases.english: Rise again, stronger than before
phrases.spanish: Levántate de nuevo, más fuerte

phrases.english: I forgive you, I let go
phrases.spanish: Te perdono, lo dejo ir

phrases.english: I'm sorry, please forgive me
phrases.spanish: Lo siento, por favor, perdóname

phrases.english: Let's move forward, without blame
phrases.spanish: Sigamos adelante, sin culpas

phrases.english: I understand, I forgive you
phrases.spanish: Entiendo, te perdono

phrases.english: Healing takes time, I choose peace
phrases.spanish: La sanación toma tiempo, elijo paz

phrases.english: Breathe softly, notice the moment
phrases.spanish: Respira suave, nota el momento

phrases.english: Feel your feet, connect with earth
phrases.spanish: Siente tus pies, conéctate con la tierra

phrases.english: Soft eyes, calm breath, open heart
phrases.spanish: Ojos suaves, respiración calma, corazón abierto

phrases.english: Notice thoughts, let them pass
phrases.spanish: Observa los pensamientos, déjalos pasar

phrases.english: One breath, one step, be present
phrases.spanish: Una respiración, un paso, está presente
